description: This PHP class provides debugging utilities for the JmesPath expression language engine, including AST and token dumps, and supports interpreted and compiled runtimes.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: A debugging class for JmesPath that outputs token, AST, and code information, and times the execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes DebugRuntime with a runtime callable and optional output stream.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the debugging process, selecting interpreted or compiled mode.

methods.name: debugInterpreted
methods.description: Runs the interactive debugging process for interpreted runtime.

methods.name: debugCompiled
methods.description: Runs debugging for compiled runtime and dumps the generated code.

methods.name: dumpTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes the expression and outputs tokens.

methods.name: dumpAst
methods.description: Parses the expression into AST and outputs it.

methods.name: dumpCompiledCode
methods.description: Outputs the generated PHP code for the compiled expression.

methods.name: debugCallback
methods.description: Handles the debugging steps, including timing, and output of expression, tokens, AST, data, and results.
